$comment: How the Brain answers eval questions asked 'as a role' (docs/eval-contract.md). A role is either a real person whose access matches it, or a profile: a set of the company's groups, so the role gets that access and nobody's personal files. From the permission exports (group_members.csv, sharepoint_permissions.csv, VDR access report).

ROLE-CEO-BUYER.why: New owner running the company: the owners' access (Owners & Execs: Accounting, deal folders, data room), management and all-staff; no personal mailboxes or HR files. The Northgate buyer's own guest account (Rachel Stein) is narrower.

ROLE-OPS-MGR.why: Runs field operations across branches: management, dispatch and field-service access; no personal mailbox

ROLE-FINANCE.why: The Accounting group (Accounting library, billing mailbox, QuickBooks exports); not the owners group
